project.name: Community equipment library
project.requirements: I run a community equipment library. I need a website where members reserve tools, volunteers check them out and back in, and overdue reminders go by email. We already have a public website and a spreadsheet of members. We are in Australia. Please help me build this on Azure.

data.label: Existing public website
data.description: Existing externally managed website, preserved outside provisioning scope. Propose adding a link to the borrowing application; hosting platform and change ownership remain unknown.

data.label: Existing member spreadsheet
data.description: Existing member records; file platform, fields and permissions are unknown. Propose an operator-reviewed initial import with validation and duplicate detection, rather than assuming continuous spreadsheet synchronization. Membership authority after import remains to be agreed.

data.label: Members and volunteers
data.description: Existing people accessing the application through browsers, outside provisioning scope. Members reserve equipment; authorized volunteers record checkout and return. People may hold both roles.

data.label: Equipment borrowing website
data.description: Proposed Azure App Service hosts the new browser interface and server API. Owns inventory, reservations, checkout/return, server-side member/volunteer permissions, reviewed member import and audit events. Transactions prevent overlapping confirmed reservations. A scheduled WebJob within this deployment processes a durable SQL reminder outbox with bounded retries and duplicate suppression. Reminder timing and loan rules remain open. Custom source, deployment, identity integration and tests are required; no supplied application image or generated workload exists. Australia East is proposed; availability and residency require review.

data.label: Members, equipment and loans
data.description: Proposed Azure SQL Database stores member-to-login mappings, volunteer permissions, equipment, reservations, loan history, audit events and reminder outbox. Application access uses a narrowly scoped managed identity; browsers receive no database access. Transactional booking checks and idempotent loan changes require implementation. Backup, restore, retention and operating ownership remain design work. Australia East proposed, unverified.

data.label: Member and volunteer sign-in
data.description: Proposed Microsoft Entra External ID handles member-facing sign-in. The application separately enforces approved membership and volunteer permissions; successful sign-in never grants volunteer access by itself. Admission model awaits the user's decision. Tenant geography, recovery and supported sign-in configuration require review and custom integration.

data.label: Overdue reminder email
data.description: Proposed Azure Communication Services Email sends overdue reminders requested by the application worker. Requires verified sender/domain, supported data location and delivery-status handling. Exact provisioning resources and API authorization require engineering. Provider acceptance is distinct from inbox delivery; uncertain sends require reconciliation before retry. No service availability or Australian-only processing is established.

history.text: I run a community equipment library. I need a website where members reserve tools, volunteers check them out and back in, and overdue reminders go by email. We already have a public website and a spreadsheet of members. We are in Australia. Please help me build this on Azure.

We’re building an Azure borrowing website for member reservations, volunteer checkouts and returns, and overdue emails, alongside your existing website and member spreadsheet. Let’s sketch the application and its connections; these workflows need custom application engineering, with no AI required.

**Should website access be limited to approved members, or can anyone join online?** This determines how we handle registration—for example, “only members already approved in our spreadsheet”; “not sure” is fine.
